title: Practice 3: Where: над, под, за, перед, между

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Мудрость не довлеет над ___ (сила).
exercises.prompt: Wisdom does not prevail over power.
exercises.why: «над» + instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я тоже под ___ (подозрение).
exercises.why: «под» + instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Акционеры были обеспокоены стремительным расширением компании за ___ (рубеж).
exercises.prompt: Shareholders were concerned about the company's swift expansion overseas.
exercises.why: «за» + instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Перед ___ (сон) помещение необходимо проветривать.
exercises.prompt: Before going to sleep, it is necessary to ventilate the room.
exercises.why: «перед» + instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том не знает разницы между ___ (викинги) и норвежцами.
exercises.prompt: Tom doesn't know the difference between Vikings and Norwegians.
exercises.why: «между» + instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: They worked jointly on this project.
exercises.why: «над» + instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom and Mary built their house in the shade of an old oak tree.
exercises.ru: Том и Мэри построили дом под ___ старого дуба.
exercises.why: «под» + instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Be a pal and go out for some bread. At the same time, take out the trash.
exercises.ru: Будь другом, сгоняй за ___. И мусор заодно вынеси.
exercises.why: «за» + instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The witnesses appeared before the judge.
exercises.why: «перед» + instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: There's a big difference between frugality and stinginess.

exercises.why: «между» + instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Над ___ (стол) висела хрустальная люстра.
exercises.prompt: A crystal chandelier was hanging over the table.
exercises.why: «над» + instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Что ты имеешь в виду под ___ (культурный релятивизм)?
exercises.prompt: What do you mean by cultural relativism?

exercises.q: За ___ (эпоха) Сёва следует эпоха Хэйсей.
exercises.prompt: Heisei is next after the Showa era.
exercises.why: «за» + instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Лошадь заартачилась перед ___ (барьер).
exercises.prompt: The horse balked at the jump.
exercises.why: «перед» + instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Существует нерушимая связь между ___ (язык) и культурой.

exercises.why: «между» + instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.why: «над» + instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom was sitting below an apple tree.
exercises.why: «под» + instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: What is the difference between a stalactite and a stalagmite?
